newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady on firmer cargo prices.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady on firmer cargo prices.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were firm as sellers raised their offers due to firmer overnight cargo prices amid moderate enquiries, traders said on Friday.
They said 380-cst sellers were at $107/$108 per tonne and 180-cst was offered at around $110-$111.
"The sellers are bringing up their offers because of the higher cargo prices. Most people are not keen to drop their offers as the cargo prices prices are rising," one supplier said.
MDO and gas oil were indicated at $168 and $178 per tonne, respectively.
